title: Three consecutive screen dates produced the same 100 rows, and the desk neither says so nor stops paying for the walk
hypothesis: A screen's content is a function of the bar library's basis day, not of its screen date, so when the library has not advanced a new screen run re-walks 101 members to record a snapshot whose rows are byte-identical to yesterday's (only basis_age_days moves); saying that on the page -- and possibly short-circuiting it the way J-18's identical-pin pre-check already does -- is the daily desk's most repeated wasted read.
